author: terencechain
content:
today, in 12s, there's dead weight, so it's easy to argue for shorter slot time
in epbs, today's dead weight is being utilized to scale execution and blobs
so at some point, you will have to consider the trade off, do you want faster slot time, or do you want more gas limit / blobs per slot

author: greystroke
content: I would say there is a middle ground between scaling by bigger slots versus faster slots. After Glamsterdam gas increases, I think that balance will be a bit out of whack. There are properties provided by faster slot time that aren't resolved by bigger slots alone such as mev reduction, faster finality,  better support for cross-chain intra-op and better UX.
